title: Pearl S. Buck: The First American Woman to Win a Nobel Prize in Literature
titleZh: 赛珍珠：首位获诺贝尔文学奖的美国女性
credits: Jim Tedder wrote this story for VOA Learning English. John Russell adapted it.

sentences.en: The year was 1931.
sentences.zh: 那一年是1931年。

sentences.en: The top selling book in the United States was The Good Earth by Pearl S. Buck.
sentences.zh: 当时美国最畅销的书是赛珍珠写的《大地》。

sentences.en: The following year, Buck won the Pulitzer Prize for the best novel by an American writer.
sentences.zh: 次年，赛珍珠凭借美国作家的最佳小说作品获得了普利策奖。

sentences.en: In 1938, Buck became the first American woman to be awarded the Nobel Prize in Literature.
sentences.zh: 1938年，赛珍珠成为首位获得诺贝尔文学奖的美国女性。

sentences.en: She wrote more than one hundred books.
sentences.zh: 她写了一百多本书。

sentences.en: She also wrote short stories, poetry, plays, essays, and children’s books.
sentences.zh: 她还写过短篇小说、诗歌、戏剧、散文和儿童读物。

sentences.en: But most people remember Pearl Buck for her novels about China.
sentences.zh: 但大多数人记得赛珍珠，是因为她那些关于中国的小说。

sentences.en: She knew the country and its people very well.
sentences.zh: 她非常了解这个国家及其人民。

sentences.en: For nearly 40 years, China was her home.
sentences.zh: 将近40年，中国就是她的家。

sentences.en: Pearl’s parents were Caroline and Absalom Sydenstricker.
sentences.zh: 赛珍珠的父母是卡罗琳和亚伯拉罕·西登斯里克。

sentences.en: They were religious workers in China.
sentences.zh: 他们在中国从事宗教工作。

sentences.en: Pearl’s education began at home.
sentences.zh: 赛珍珠的教育从家中开始。

sentences.en: Her mother taught her many of the things she would have learned in an American school.
sentences.zh: 她的母亲教了她许多在美国学校本会学到的东西。

sentences.en: A Chinese teacher taught Pearl other subjects.
sentences.zh: 一位中文教师教赛珍珠其他科目。

sentences.en: In 1910, Pearl went back to the United States to study philosophy at Randolph-Macon Woman’s College in Lynchburg, Virginia.
sentences.zh: 1910年，赛珍珠回到美国，在弗吉尼亚州林奇堡的伦道夫-梅肯女子学院研究哲学。

sentences.en: After graduation, she returned to China.
sentences.zh: 毕业后，她回到了中国。

sentences.en: Three years later, she met John Lossing Buck.
sentences.zh: 三年后，她遇到了约翰·洛辛·西登斯里克。

sentences.en: He was a religious worker who studied agriculture.
sentences.zh: 他是一位从事农业研究的宗教工作者。

sentences.en: They were married and moved to a small village in the north of China.
sentences.zh: 他们结婚后搬到了中国北方的一个小村庄。

sentences.en: Their life among the poorest people provided the subject matter for many of the books she later wrote.
sentences.zh: 他们与最贫穷的人们一起生活，为日后她所写的许多书籍提供了素材。

sentences.en: The Good Earth
sentences.zh: 《大地》

sentences.en: The Good Earth is the story of a poor Chinese man named Wang Lung.
sentences.zh: 《大地》讲述了一个名叫王龙的中国穷人的故事。

sentences.en: His wife is O-Lan.
sentences.zh: 他的妻子叫阿兰。

sentences.en: They work very hard together and finally make enough money to buy some land for a farm.
sentences.zh: 他们一起辛勤劳作，终于攒够了钱，买下一块地来经营农场。

sentences.en: After a time, they grow enough crops to feed their family well, with some left over to sell.
sentences.zh: 过了一段时间，他们种出了足够的庄稼来好好养活家人，还有剩余可以出售。

sentences.en: Their lives get much better, and they are happy.
sentences.zh: 他们的生活变得好多了，也很幸福。

sentences.en: But the good times do not last.
sentences.zh: 然而好日子并没有持续太久。

sentences.en: Pearl Buck wrote her first books about China at a time when most people in the world knew almost nothing about the Chinese way of life.
sentences.zh: 珀尔·贝克在大多数人几乎对中国的生活方式一无所知的时候，写下了她关于中国的第一批作品。

sentences.en: After almost 40 years in China, the writer moved back to the United States.
sentences.zh: 在中国生活了近40年后，这位作家搬回了美国。

sentences.en: She bought Green Hills Farm in eastern Pennsylvania.
sentences.zh: 她买下了宾夕法尼亚东部的一处青山农场。

sentences.en: She began to write articles for newspapers and magazines.
sentences.zh: 她开始为报纸和杂志撰写文章。

sentences.en: She expressed her opinions on war, politics, religion, equal rights for all people and many other subjects.
sentences.zh: 她就战争、政治、宗教、人人平等权利以及许多其他主题发表自己的看法。

sentences.en: She also gave many speeches.
sentences.zh: 她还做了许多演讲。

sentences.en: Buck talked to young people about the importance of a good education.
sentences.zh: 贝克就良好教育的重要性对年轻人发表讲话。

sentences.en: She also told them they needed to know more about other people around the world.
sentences.zh: 她还告诉他们，他们需要更多地了解世界上其他各地的人们。

sentences.en: Pearl Buck died in 1973 at the age of 80.
sentences.zh: 珀尔·贝克于1973年去世，享年80岁。

sentences.en: I’m John Russell.
sentences.zh: 我是约翰·拉塞尔。

glossary.def: an invented narrative that is usually complex and deals with the human experience
glossary.zh: 小说 (n.): 虚构的叙事作品；长篇小说

glossary.def: the award or acceptance of an academic degree
glossary.zh: 毕业 (n.): 获得学位；毕业

glossary.def: a relatively short piece of writing that appears in newspapers or magazines
glossary.zh: 文章 (n.): 报刊上的短文；报道
